what: node_classes/concept-piece.json carries NO workflow_versions. Decide its workflow — or decide it does not get one, and say what that means.
why_it_needs_adjudication: The class carries everything EXCEPT the machine-readable string: invariant, prove_gate (quorum signature — review, not build), kicks_back_on, one member (press_office/IntentionBasedDesignForHumans.md). Two ratified sources contradict: tickets/ticket-and-task.json's 'concept-piece@v1' string claims THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> LEARNME -> PROVED, while tickets/state-machine-physics.json says THINKME -> REVIEWME -> PROVED. The first is code-seam's path copied onto a class that does not build, so the drift has a direction and CC's read is that state-machine-physics is right — but a class definition is RATIFIED BY AKIEN (node_classes/_charter+why.json signature gate), so CC does not get to pick.
blocks: 1 of 17 fleet nodes cannot validate its workflow string at all ('unknown workflow version v1, known: []'). ticket-and-task.json is that node.
